defensiveAbilities.name: Extraneous Flesh
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency three times per day

Trigger A Strike scores a critical hit on the bhanyada scavenger

Effect A critical hit might simply sever a component chunk that the bhanyada can lose without much harm. The bhanyada scavenger attempts a DC 11 Flat . On a success, it doesn't take any extra damage from the critical hit (although it takes other effects normally, such as critical specialization effects).

defensiveAbilities.name: Odor of Rot
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. Creatures other than aberrations that enter or start their turn in the bhanyada's aura must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Change Posture
offensiveAbilities.description: The bhanyada changes between a bipedal and quadrupedal stance. In its bipedal stance, the bhanyada can't use Sudden Charge. In its quadrupedal stance, it loses its climb Speed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gnashing Bite
offensiveAbilities.description: The bhanyada's teeth shift in its mouth as it bites. The bhanyada makes a jaws Strike. On a hit, the target takes an additional 2d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage, and the target is Slowed 1 for 1 round if the Strike dealt bludgeoning damage, or takes 1d8 Persistent,bleed Damage damage if the Strike dealt piercing damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The bhanyada Strides twice and makes a jaws Strike at the end of its movement.
